audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts read Gnar/Gnar/Gnar/Skill/Gnar/Skill/Gnar — Gnar winning the 2-item stage outright. Packet says Gnar,Gnar,Gnar,Gnar,Skill,Gnar,Yorick and the whys[] prose matches the packet. Separately, diff is set to 'HARD' while diffRating is 6/10, tone is the even-matchup yellow, report[14] says 'Even matchup' and the win rate is 52.62% in Gnar's favour.
audit.why: whys[3] says a Mega Wallop 'punishes every Mourning Mist + ghoul commit he makes' — that is a Gnar stage, marked Skill. whys[4] literally calls level 6 'a coinflip' — marked Gnar. whys[5] says your poke keeps him off the wave — marked Skill. whys[6] and late both say Maiden takes over and you cannot solo him — marked Gnar. The 'HARD' label contradicts four other fields on the same page.
audit.corrected: Gnar / Gnar / Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Gnar / Yorick as one atomic group, and diff HARD -> EVEN to match the rating, tone, report[14] and win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer spikes said 'Stridebreaker'; Yorick's real spike is Eulogy of the Isles at 6 (160s at rank 1) and his ghoul stack, neither of which was dated.
audit.why: 160s at rank 1 is one of the longest ultimates in the game — a Maiden that has just been killed or expired is a four-minute window where Yorick is a dashless melee with no swarm. That is the single most actionable timing in this lane and the page never mentions it.
audit.corrected: Phase whys now key to Maiden and the ghoul stack rather than a generic item spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is described everywhere as an inescapable cage — dontsFull[0] 'Get caged', breakdown.cooldowns "Don't get caged", and content late says outright 'there is no Hop out of a full cage'. Riot's own text says it is a DESTRUCTIBLE wall. The page also never states that Last Rites is an auto reset that heals, or that Mourning Mist reduces armour.
audit.why: This is the most consequential error in the matchup: the page tells the reader a survivable situation is a death sentence and gives no counterplay. The wall can be broken — attacking a segment opens a gap, and Gnar's Hop then clears it. Both flagged missing interactions also land on Last Rites: it heals (so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades) and it resets his auto (so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast). Mourning Mist cutting armour is why his ghoul swarm hurts far more than its raw numbers suggest.
audit.corrected: Stated the wall's destructibility and the break-and-Hop counterplay, Last Rites' 6s auto-reset heal and the anti-heal requirement, and Mourning Mist's armour reduction plus its 12s cooldown.

edits.before: You win every straight skirmish until Maiden of the Mist comes out, then Yorick becomes a sidelane problem you cannot solo. His full ghoul army plus Maiden grind down your form-dependent burst, and a W (Dark Procession) ghoul-wall dropped on your Mini body with Rage on cooldown is a death sentence — there is no Hop out of a full cage. Close the game on your mid-game teamfight power: your GNAR! wall-combo is a far better fight-starter than anything he brings to a 5v5, and you should never try to match his splitpush 1v1 after two items.
edits.after: You win every straight skirmish until Maiden of the Mist comes out, then Yorick becomes a sidelane problem you cannot solo. His full ghoul army plus Maiden grind down your form-dependent burst, and a W (Dark Procession) ghoul-wall dropped on your Mini body with Rage on cooldown is near-lethal — but the wall is destructible, so break a segment and Hop the gap rather than panicking. Close on your mid-game teamfight power: the GNAR! wall-combo starts fights better than anything he brings to a 5v5, and never match his splitpush 1v1 after two items.

notes: Most important fix: the page told the reader Dark Procession was an inescapable death sentence — content late said in so many words 'there is no Hop out of a full cage'. Riot's text calls it a destructible wall. Breaking a segment and hopping the gap is the actual counterplay and it appeared nowhere on the page. Corrected in late, dontsFull[0].d, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, tldr and the cooldown block. Both missing interactions land on Last Rites (a 6s auto reset that heals) and are now stated with the anti-heal requirement and the wind-up tell. Also flipped diff from HARD to EVEN — it was the only field on the page saying hard, against a 6/10 rating, the even-matchup tone colour, report[14]'s own 'Even matchup' text and a 52.62% win rate. Content layer was otherwise accurate and correctly named throughout. Not verified: how many autos or how much damage it takes to break one Dark Procession segment, and whether Mega Gnar's size prevents Hopping through a one-segment gap — so I wrote the counterplay without a damage figure.
